desc: Ideation and approach selection: prime-wise exponent DP with seen-zero flag.
Implement complete solution: factor A_i, build per-prime exponent sequences, precompute powers, run two-state height DP for each prime, multiply results modulo 998244353.
Validate against samples and edge cases (all A_i=1, N=2, repeated zero-difference steps, large exponent sums).
